title: Mortgage Loan File Terminal Statuses: Withdrawal, Denial, Incompleteness and Rescission
content:
**Withdrawal.** Only the borrower can withdraw an application on a Mortgage Loan File; a real estate agent, seller or co-signer cannot withdraw it for them.

**Denial.** A denial is an underwriting decision recorded by Larkspur and is followed by an adverse action notice.

**Closure for incompleteness.** A suspended file is closed for incompleteness only after the suspense period that started on its suspended date has run out. Calendar days are counted forward from the file's suspended date, which is day zero; the file may be closed on the day after the last day of the period. The period is the program's suspense period in calendar days, and the evidence is the suspended date stamped on the file. Before closing the file Larkspur sends a notice of incompleteness giving the program's notice response period in days to complete it.

**Effects of a terminal status.** Every terminal status stamps the file's closed date with the date it took effect (a rescission keeps the consummation date already stamped); withdrawal, denial, intent-to-proceed lapse and closure for incompleteness cancel any open rate lock on the file and forfeit any closing cost credit not yet applied.

**Rescission.** A consummated refinance is rescinded only by the borrower, within the rescission period recorded on the closing.

**No reopening.** A file in rescinded, withdrawn, denied or closed-incomplete status is never reopened; the borrower starts a new application.

## Suspense period, worked through (hypothetical, 30-day period)

| Suspended date (day zero) | Last day of the period | Earliest closure for incompleteness |
|---|---|---|
| 1 September | 1 October (day 30) | 2 October |

Under a 45-day period (the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed program) a file suspended on 1 September reaches day 45 on 16 October and may be closed from 17 October.

## Who may act

| Action | Who |
|---|---|
| Withdraw an application | the borrower only |
| Deny | Larkspur, as an underwriting decision |
| Rescind a consummated refinance | the borrower only, within the recorded rescission period |
